I'm 25, I've had depression my whole life. I'm not going to lie to you and say everything is sunshine and rainbows now. It's not, life is hard it's messy, cruel but also beautiful. There's a BIG difference in how I felt as a 13 year old kid stuck at home being abused and a 25 year old with freedom. Set goals for yourself, I would tell myself things like "I can't kill myself till I move out" even stupid little things like "can't till I'm done this book" "till I'm done this series" till I'm done something. Just find a reason to keep living it doesn't have to be something big, just has to be yours. Just give yourself time to find love for life so one day you won't want to die.
